description_en:
Creates an edge container application version. You can iteratively release applications by version.
Note:
Your account must have an ESA plan with the Edge Container feature enabled.
Call CreateEdgeContainerApp first to create an application and obtain the AppId.
Complete call chain example: CreateEdgeContainerApp → ListEdgeContainerApps → CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion
description_zh:
创建边缘容器应用版本，可以按照版本进行应用的迭代发布。
注意：
账号须开通含 Edge Container 功能的 ESA 计划；
须先调用 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建应用并获取 AppId；
给出完整调用链示例（CreateEdgeContainerApp → ListEdgeContainerApps → CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion）

name: CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) operation to obtain the application ID.
<notice>1) Your account must have an ESA plan with the Edge Container feature enabled. 2) Call CreateEdgeContainerApp first to create an application and obtain the AppId. 3) Complete call chain example: CreateEdgeContainerApp → ListEdgeContainerApps → CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~)接口获取应用ID。
<notice>1) 账号须开通含 Edge Container 功能的 ESA 计划；2) 须先调用 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建应用并获取 AppId；3) 给出完整调用链示例（CreateEdgeContainerApp → ListEdgeContainerApps → CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion）。</notice>

parameters.help_en: The version name. The name must be 6 to 128 characters in length

fields.help_en: The ACR image domain name
fields.help_zh: ACR镜像域名

fields.help_zh: ACR站点实例ID
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the image is an enterprise-level image
fields.help_zh: 是否为企业级镜像
fields.name: is_enterprise_registry

fields.help_en: The region list of the ACR instance
fields.help_zh: ACR 镜像站点实例区域列表
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The repository ID of the image
fields.help_zh: 镜像的仓库ID

fields.help_en: The image repository name
fields.help_zh: 镜像仓库名称
fields.name: repo_name

fields.help_en: The namespace of the image repository
fields.help_zh: 指定镜像仓库命名空间名称
fields.name: repo_namespace

fields.help_en: The ACR image tag
fields.help_zh: ACR镜像标签
fields.name: tag

fields.help_en: The ACR image tag URL
fields.help_zh: ACR镜像标签地址
fields.name: tag_url

fields.help_en: The ACR image information
fields.help_zh: ACR镜像信息
fields.name: acr_image_info

fields.help_en: The startup parameters. Separate multiple parameters with spaces
fields.help_zh: 启动参数。表示启动参数，多个以空格分割
fields.name: args

fields.help_en: The startup command. Separate multiple commands with spaces
fields.help_zh: 探针运行命令。表示启动命令，多个以空格分割
fields.name: command

fields.help_en: The environment variables. Format: key1=val1,key2=val2
fields.help_zh: 环境变量。表示环境变量，格式为：key1=val1,key2=val2
fields.name: env_variables

fields.help_en: The image address
fields.help_zh: 镜像地址
fields.name: image

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the image is an Alibaba Cloud Container Registry (ACR) image
fields.help_zh: 是否为ACR镜像
fields.name: is_acr_image

fields.help_en: The container name. The name must be unique within the same container group
fields.help_zh: 容器名称，同一个容器组下命名唯一
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The command to execute before the container starts. Separate multiple commands with spaces. This command is executed before the service starts and is typically used for initialization operations
fields.help_zh: 容器启动前执行命令。表示启动之前的命令，以空格为分隔，服务启动之前执行，一般用于初始化操作
fields.name: post_start

fields.help_en: The command to execute before the container stops. Separate multiple commands with spaces. This command is executed before the service exits and is typically used for cleanup operations before exit
fields.help_zh: 容器停止前执行命令。表示启动之后的命令，以空格为分隔，服务退出之前执行，一般用于退出前的清理操作
fields.name: pre_stop

fields.example: 具体字段可参照k8s官方就绪探针的定义。

fields.help_en: The probe command for exec-type probes
fields.help_zh: exec 类型探针探测命令
fields.name: command

fields.help_en: The number of consecutive failed health checks required
fields.help_zh: 容器健康检查连续失败次数
fields.name: failure_threshold

fields.help_en: The domain name for the health check
fields.help_zh: 健康检查的域名
fields.name: host

fields.help_en: The HTTP request headers
fields.help_zh: HTTP请求头
fields.name: http_headers

fields.help_en: The initial delay time for the container probe. Unit: seconds. For example, 5 indicates that the initial delay time is set to 5 seconds
fields.help_zh: 容器探针初始化延迟时间。单位为秒，比如：5，代表初始化延迟时间设置为5秒
fields.name: initial_delay_seconds

fields.help_en: The path for the container health check
fields.help_zh: 容器健康检查的路径
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: The interval for the container health check. Unit: seconds. For example, 5 indicates that the health check interval is set to 5 seconds
fields.help_zh: 容器健康检查的间隔时间。单位为秒，比如：5，代表健康检查的间隔时间设置为5秒
fields.name: period_seconds

fields.help_en: The port for the container health check
fields.help_zh: 容器健康检查的端口
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The request protocol for the health check
fields.help_zh: 健康检查的请求协议
fields.name: scheme

fields.help_en: The number of consecutive successful health checks required
fields.help_zh: 健康检查连续成功次数
fields.name: success_threshold

fields.help_en: The timeout period for the container health check. Unit: seconds. For example, 5 indicates that the timeout period is set to 5 seconds
fields.help_zh: 容器健康检查的超时时间。单位为秒，比如：5，代表超时时间设置为5秒
fields.name: timeout_seconds

fields.help_en: The container health probe content
fields.help_zh: 容器健康探针内容
fields.name: probe_content

fields.help_en:
The probe type. Valid values:
exec: Command-based.
tcpSocket: TCP detection-based.
httpGet: HTTP access-based
fields.help_zh:
探针类型，支持如下几种类型：
exec： 命令型。
tcpSocket：tcp探测型。
httpGet：http访问型
fields.name: probe_type

fields.help_en: The container specifications. Specifies the computing specifications. Valid values: 1C2G, 2C4G, 2C8G, 4C8G, 4C16G, 8C16G, and 8C32G
fields.help_zh: 容器规格。表示算力规格，取值范围（1C2G | 2C4G | 2C8G | 4C8G | 4C16G | 8C16G | 8C32G）
fields.name: spec

fields.help_en: The storage capacity. Valid values: 0.5G, 10G, 20G, and 30G
fields.help_zh: 存储信息。标识存储空间，取值范围（0.5G | 10G | 20G | 30G）
fields.name: storage

parameters.help_en: The container group to be deployed for this version, including specific image information. The image information consists of the image address, startup command, parameters, environment variables, and probe rules. Multiple images are supported in a JSON array structure
parameters.help_zh:
该版本要部署的容器组，包含具体的镜像信息。    
镜像信息，由镜像地址及启动命令、参数、环境变量、探针规则等构成，支持多个镜像，json数组结构
parameters.name: containers

VersionId.description_en: The ID of the created version
